about: The ledger of books: chosen (queued), being transcribed (in progress), published, waiting for an answer from Tom, and rejected. Rules: notes/selection.md. `order` is a suggestion, not an obligation.

books.title: Diary of the Late Rajah of Kolhapoor, during His Visit to Europe in 1870
books.author: Rajaram, Rajah of Kolhapur; edited by Edward W. West
books.eligibility: Checked 2026-11-19: not in the Project Gutenberg catalogue, The Online Books Page (page images only, if listed), Wikisource or Faded Page; only print-on-demand reprints found. Not checked: WorldCat, Distributed Proofreaders in progress. Reprints seen: Creative Media, CreateSpace, Forgotten Books (print on demand). A Marathi translation (2025) is not an English edition. Re-checked 2026-11-19: Gutenberg catalogue, web search (only the 1872 edition, a Forgotten Books print-on-demand reprint, and the 2025 Marathi translation). Editor's death date not found: see the book log and Questions for Tom. Tom, 2026-11-19: publish; a person whose death date is unknown is assumed to have died before age 100 (West, a captain by 1870, was born about 1840 or earlier).
books.note: Using the University of California scan diaryoflaterajah00rajarich (200 leaves) rather than the Google scan. Short; a Google scan of a Michigan copy (greyscale, clean on the sampled page): check every page before starting. Editor's introduction and notes are part of the book.

books.title: Flying Leaves from East and West
books.author: Emily Pfeiffer
books.eligibility: Checked 2026-11-19: not in the Project Gutenberg catalogue, The Online Books Page (page images only, if listed), Wikisource or Faded Page; only print-on-demand reprints found. Not checked: WorldCat, Distributed Proofreaders in progress. No reprint of any kind found. Re-checked 2026-11-19 before starting: still not in the Project Gutenberg catalogue (pg_catalog.csv: only Ida Pfeiffer's books); web searches of the title and of a sentence from p. 73 find no text and no edition. Emily Pfeiffer 1827–1890.
books.note: University of California scan, clean and complete (checked 2026-11-19). All prose: two parts, 'From the East' (Leaves I–VI: Smyrna, Constantinople, Athens) and 'From the West' (Leaves I–XIX: United States and Canada); a few footnotes, a few verse quotations, no plates.
books.waiting_for: Tom: may the session transcribe the five refused leaves itself from the page images (checked by the Sonnet corrections pass and the Opus judge)? The output filter refused the Opus draft of p0116-p0118 and p0128-p0129 on 2026-11-19 and again, in a later session, the same day. Everything else is done; see wip/flying-leaves-pfeiffer/log.md.

books.title: South by West; or, Winter in the Rocky Mountains and Spring in Mexico
books.author: Rose Georgina Kingsley; edited by Charles Kingsley
books.eligibility: Checked 2026-11-19: not in the Project Gutenberg catalogue, The Online Books Page (page images only, if listed), Wikisource or Faded Page; only print-on-demand reprints found. Not checked: WorldCat, Distributed Proofreaders in progress. Reprints seen: Kessinger, Creative Media (print on demand). Re-checked 2026-11-19: not in pg_catalog.csv (Rose Kingsley's other books are); The Online Books Page lists page images only (Germany); web search finds only Kessinger (2007/2010), Creative Media Partners (2023) and other print-on-demand reprints. An ISBN 0-87380-148-2 (Rio Grande Press, a real reprint house) seen near it in results is Schwatka's In the Land of Cave and Cliff Dwellers, not this book. Editor Charles Kingsley d. 1875; author d. 1925; the engravers are not named in the book (work done by 1874, so its makers died before 1955 under rule 5).
books.note: University of California scan. Preface by Charles Kingsley; some plates.
books.waiting_for: Tom, 2026-11-19: skip for the time being and try again in the future. Problem: the output filter refused 3 pages of the Opus draft. Work so far (413 drafted pages, crops) is in wip/south-by-west-kingsley/; see its log.
